segments.title: Apple went down. Don't tap THIS
segments.say: Apple went down this week. Don't tap this text.

segments.title: Nov 17: Apple services down
segments.say: On November seventeenth, iCloud sign-in, iCloud Mail, the App Store and Apple Music had outages, from about a quarter to one.

segments.title: Apple: an internal update
segments.say: Apple said an internal update caused it, and many systems were back up that afternoon.

segments.title: Scam texts come next
segments.say: After an outage, don't tap any verify your Apple ID texts or emails.

segments.title: Sign in the safe way
segments.say: Sign in only through Settings, or by typing apple dot com yourself. Not tested by us.
Follow for Phone Trick number 11 tomorrow.
